Triaged per `ticket-triage` skill. Applied: `ai`, `core` (primary `enhancement` already present). Stage retrospective passed. Self-assigned for implementation.

### Ticket Intake & Contract Ledger (`ticket-intake` §0, §1.7, §1.8)

- **Prescription checked:** `src/manager/DomEvent.mjs` (`verifyDelegationPath`) — owns the concern.
  - `src/main/DomEvents.mjs#getTargetData` already serializes `data` (`{...node.dataset}`), `aria` (`geAriaAttributes(node)`), and attribute-backed `role` (`node.getAttribute('role')`) and `tabIndex` (`node.getAttribute('tabindex')`) on every entry in `path`.
  - Extending `DomEvent#verifyDelegationPath` to tokenize `delegate` via `delegate.match(/\[[^\]]+\]|\S+/g)` and match bracketed attribute selectors (`[attr=value]`, `[attr="value"]`, `[attr='value']`, and presence-only `[attr]`) against `path[j].data` (for `data-*`, supporting both `Neo.camel(key)` dataset keys and raw keys), `path[j].aria` (for `aria-*`), `path[j].role` (for `role`), and `path[j].tabIndex` (for `tabindex`) enables `[data-ref=foo]` and multi-node chains like `.parent [data-ref="foo"]` without matching DOM properties (`style`, `id`, `tagName`, `draggable`, `checked`, `hidden`, `inert`) when the underlying HTML attribute is absent.
- **Core-Idiom Pre-Flight (`§9.6`):** Read `src/core/Base.mjs`, `src/Neo.mjs`, and `src/state/Provider.mjs`.

#### Contract Ledger
| Surface | Owner / File | Change | Consumer / Verification |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.manager.DomEvent#verifyDelegationPath` & `matchesAttributeTarget` | `src/manager/DomEvent.mjs` | String `delegate` grammar: space-separated simple selectors (`#id`, `.cls`, bare class name, `[attr]`, `[attr=value]` with optional quotes and spaces inside `[]`); supported attribute names: `data-*`, `aria-*`, `role`, `tabindex`; compound selectors on one node (e.g. `.btn[data-ref=foo]`) are not supported and do not match | `test/playwright/unit/manager/domEvent/Delegation.spec.mjs` |

#### Ticket Reality Classification
- **Ticket age:** `createdAt: 2023-10-10T18:10:32Z`, `updatedAt: 2026-10-09T20:38:54Z`
- **Bot stale-band:** `post-stale-with-exemption` (reopened and re-validated in `#19489` set C by `@neo-opus-grace` on `2026-10-09`)
- **Currency / successor-risk evidence:** Verified live `src/manager/DomEvent.mjs` (`L624–662`) and `test/playwright/unit/manager/domEvent/Delegation.spec.mjs`; only `#id` and `.class` string delegates are currently handled.
- **Verdict:** `valid-as-written`.
